 All moneys received by way of gifts, bequests , donations,
subscriptions, contributions, fees or grants for and on account of the

(3) There shall be established a depreciation fund and a sinking
fund for the rehabilitation, development and improvement of the
property.
(4) There shall be paid out of the Fund, all sums of money as are
required to defray any expenditure incurred by the Foundation in the
exercise, performance and discharge of its powers, duties and
functions under the Act.

7.
(1) The Foundation shall cause proper accounts to be kept of
its income and expenditure.
(2) The account or accounts shall be audited annually by the
auditor of the Foundation.

(3)
The financial year of the Foundation shall be considered
from the First (1st) of January to Thirty First (31st) of December
every year.

8.
All the debs and liabilities shall be paid off by the Corporation
on the day immediately preceding the date of commencement of this
Act and the subscriptions and contributions shall be paid to the
Corporation on the same day for the purporses of this Act.

9.
(1) If upon the dissolution of the Foundaion there remains
after the satisfaction of all its debts and liabilities any peoperty
whatsoever,  such  property  shall  not  be  distributed  among  the
members of the Foundation.
(2) Such properties and liabilities shall be returned or transferred
to  any  other  institution  having  objects  similar  to  those  of  the
Foundation, having no rules made in relation to distribution of any
income or property among its members, and which is by the rules
thereof, prohibited from distributing any income or property among
its members. It shall be determined by the Board of Management
prior to the dissolution of the Foundation.
